text:
Erfurt’s median asking rent sits at 10.0 €/m² in June 2026, up 6.7 % year‑on‑year and 26.6 % over the past five years, placing the city 23rd of the 37 most expensive markets. The asking premium over existing rents is 54 %, with a typical 60 m² unit costing about 600 € per month.

The market remains balanced, with a vacancy rate of 2.5 % and an average of 29  days on market; 24 % of listings are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 14.2 %, while population growth has been modest at 0.9 % over five years, keeping affordability pressures moderate.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 10.41 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging between 10.02 €/m² and 10.71 €/m², implying a further 4.2 % rise.
